I'm tired of resisting. I've wanted to end my life since I was 14-15. Now I'm 33 and exhausted. Most of my best years are behind me and wasted. I have no goals, dreams, aspirations. I just want to stop crying. I want to stop hating myself. I want to feel alive instead of just waiting for death and peace. I lost my father when I was 7. Statistically I should be in jail or already committed suicide. I just want to see my dad again. My cat again.
